result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent secure deletion with written certification. The revision appropriately replaces only the contradictory immediate-discontinuation/deletion language in Section 11.1 while preserving the already compliant data-return and deletion provisions. The added examples of transition assistance are relevant and professionally drafted.
